create_processor_higgs_audio_v2: create a HiggsAudioV2Processor with feature_extractor, tokenizer, and audio_tokenizer for audio-text multimodal tasks
call_processor_with_audio_text: call the HiggsAudioV2Processor with text and audio inputs to tokenize and prepare batched model inputs
decode_audio_from_tokens: decode a batch of audio token sequences into audio waveforms using batch_decode method
build_delay_pattern: build a delay pattern tensor from audio input IDs for multi-codebook generation
